title: Expose runtime conceal item action complementing frisk and search_character

sections.what: Expose a runtime conceal <item> character action to tuck portable items out of plain sight until frisked, searched, or drawn, closing the authoring-only gap noted in engine/items/transfer_actions.py:252.
sections.why: engine/equipment.py (lines 260-263, 616-653) and engine/items/transfer_actions.py (lines 180-186, 247-305) already conceal items from casual view, auto-reveal on equip, and reveal on frisk/search. Yet transfer_actions.py:252 notes 'concealing it again is an authoring action' because characters lack any runtime conceal verb.
sections.how: 1. Add conceal_item(world, actor_name, item_name) in engine/items/transfer_actions.py (or equipment.py): validate size/weight fit against worn concealing garment/container capacity, unequip from hand slot into carry if held, and set item_node.properties['concealed'] = True (the clean counterpart to transfer_actions.py:252).\n2. Roll passive observer check against same-area witnesses so openly tucking away a weapon in plain view leaves a perception/turn event if noticed.\n3. Register conceal in engine/action_verbs.py, routes/action_handlers.py, PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, and contextual-actions item brackets.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest covering conceal_item size gating, unequipping on conceal, frisk/search reveal parity, and draw/equip auto-reveal (engine/equipment.py:260-263).

acceptance.text: conceal is registered in engine/action_verbs.py, PlanGrounding, routes/action_handlers.py, and contextual-actions.ts for carried items that fit concealed stowage.
Concealing a held/equipped item unequips it cleanly into carried inventory, sets concealed=True, and prevents casual room/people observation until frisked, searched, or drawn/equipped.
Optional Stealth/Sleight of Hand check informs room observers if a bystander watches the concealment attempt happen openly.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal inventory item brackets (`conceal <item>`) and command bar.

Current availability: engine/equipment.py (lines 260-263, 616-653) and engine/items/transfer_actions.py (lines 180-186, 247-305) enforce and reveal item 'concealed' flags via frisk/search, explicitly noting at line 252 that concealing an item again has no runtime action.

Manual verification steps:
1. Equip or carry a pocketable item (knife, pistol, phone, note) and run `conceal <item>`.
2. Inspect another character's room prompt (People here / bug-588) and run `frisk` / `search`.
   - expected: The concealed item disappears from casual sight until frisked or drawn again.
